product.title: Customer Labs
product.headline: Understand why customers would choose—or pass on—your product.
product.description:
Plans — one product, one run: 10 simulated customers $10; 50 for $29.99; 100 for $49.99.

Before you invest more in your product, explore what could make people choose it—and what might hold them back.

Share a short product brief or upload a Markdown (.md) file. Customer Labs researches alternatives, builds customer groups for you to review, and simulates how those customers compare your offer with competitors, their current solution, or buying nothing.

Your report explains each customer's choice in plain language, summarizes feedback by group, and suggests improvements to investigate. It also identifies concerns that could benefit from a relevant human expert. Expert sourcing and hiring are separate steps.

FAQ

What do I need to provide?
Your product name and a short description. Add a planned price and key features if you have them.

Are these real customers?
No. Profiles and responses are synthetic scenarios informed by research, not real interviews or verified demand.

What do I receive?
Collected research, customer groups and profiles, simulated choices, and a readable report with suggested improvements.

Will this predict sales?
No. Use it to form hypotheses and plan real customer tests. It does not guarantee revenue or product success.

Is expert work included?
No. Any Terac sourcing, recruitment, or paid expert work is handled separately.
